import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    arr = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    if n < 2:
        print(0)
        return
    arr.sort()
    total = arr[-1]
    for i in range(n - 2, -1, -1):
        total += arr[i]
    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
